integrity.claim_scope: The theorem is stated only for the printed deterministic delay system and positive histories.
integrity.numerical_role: Exact arithmetic is illustrative only and is not used to prove the general theorem.
integrity.proof_basis: Analytic comparison, an exact Lyapunov–Krasovskii cancellation, variation of constants, and a Barbalat argument.

scientific_limitations: The strict threshold is proved; the equality case is not resolved.
No convergence rate or description of the superthreshold regime is claimed.
A fully exhaustive comparison against inaccessible stage-structured predator literature was not possible.
title: A delay-independent global predator-extinction threshold from maturation survival
